name: 多摩川で恋してみたい AI Dance: Do the Riverbank Hand Hearts
blurb: 多摩川で恋してみたい is the TikTok dance to Yuu Ichijo's J-pop song "多摩川で、恋…したい♡" (tamagawa de koi shitai, "I want to fall in love at the Tama River"): slow sways, hand hearts and a crouch on the river stones.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 10 s, 720p, 9:16, sound on. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Animate the person in [Image 1]: they do the viral riverbank hand-heart dance, a slow retro idol-pop chorus routine, on a wide grassy riverbank at golden hour. One continuous vertical 9:16 shot with no cuts, like a phone video on a small tripod at chest height, photorealistic, warm golden light with a soft lens flare.

The dancer is the person in [Image 1], in every frame: copy the exact face from [Image 1] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles), the same build, and the clothes from [Image 1], so their friends recognize them at once. The dancer is an adult. The face stays the same from the first frame to the last, also when they smile, tilt the head or crouch. Never morph. If [Image 1] shows an animal, the dancer is that animal standing upright on its hind legs, with its own face, fur and markings, not a person.

The place: a wide, quiet riverbank in Japan at golden hour: a broad shallow river shining in the low sun, a wide bank of smooth grey river stones, tall green and golden grass, a pale concrete embankment path, low green hills and a long low bridge far away in a soft haze. No signs and no text anywhere.

The dance is a slow, sweet retro idol-pop routine, like a 1980s Japanese idol on a TV music show: gentle sways on the beat, a hand heart at the chest, small finger hearts, one arm pointing up at the sky, palms turned up beside the shoulders, a shy smile and a head tilt. Soft and cute, never fast.

0-2 s: a medium shot from the knees up: the dancer walks slowly along the stony riverbank toward the camera with a shy smile, the shining river behind them.
2-4 s: they stop, point both index fingers to one side and then to the other on the beat, then turn both palms up beside the shoulders with a little shrug.
4-6.5 s: they make a heart with both hands in front of the chest and sway gently from side to side, raise one arm and point straight up at the sky, then bring the hands back to the heart.
6.5-8.5 s: they crouch down on the river stones, face the camera and make small finger hearts at the chest, tilting the head with a sweet smile; the face is large and sharp, exactly the face from [Image 1].
8.5-10 s: still crouching, they reach both hands toward the camera with a big smile as the sun flares behind them.

Audio: an original upbeat retro J-pop idol-pop beat at a gentle, swaying mid tempo: bright synth bells, soft strings, a light drum machine, no known song, no vocals, no lyrics; a soft breeze and the river. The dancer never speaks or sings. Exactly one person, nobody else in view. No children and no famous people. No signs, no logos, no brand names, no captions, no text, no watermark. One head, two arms, two legs and five fingers per hand.
